articles.title: Deep Learning Pipeline Reconstructs Century of Urban Growth from Historical Imagery
articles.summary: Researchers developed an AI system combining CNN-LSTM-Attention-KAN architecture to analyze urban expansion from 1920-2024 using historical aerial and satellite imagery.
articles.significance: Breakthrough enables quantitative urban planning analysis across century-scale timeframes using AI

articles.title: NASA CSDA Program Announces Eight New Commercial Satellite Data Agreements
articles.summary: NASA expanded partnerships with seven commercial providers including Planet, Airbus, and SAR specialists like Capella and ICEYE for enhanced Earth observation capabilities.
articles.significance: Major expansion of NASA's commercial satellite data access for research and applications

articles.title: Polish Company Eycore Launches First European SAR Satellite
articles.summary: Eycore-1 satellite with X-band synthetic aperture radar launched on Falcon 9, making Eycore the second private European company to own a SAR satellite.
articles.significance: Advances European commercial SAR capabilities and Polish POLSARIS military radar constellation

articles.title: NRO Selects EarthDaily for Commercial Multispectral Earth Observation Support
articles.summary: National Reconnaissance Office partners with EarthDaily Analytics for 22-band multispectral satellite imagery to enhance national security monitoring workflows.
articles.significance: Integration of commercial imagery into national security and intelligence architectures

articles.title: AI Model Enables UAV Navigation in GPS-Denied Environments Using LiDAR
articles.summary: Researchers developed CLAK model using CNN-LSTM-Attention-KAN architecture for drone localization using LiDAR and non-visual sensors, achieving sub-meter accuracy.
articles.significance: Breakthrough enables autonomous navigation in challenging environments where GPS fails

articles.title: Deep Learning Pipeline Detects Rip Currents from Satellite Imagery
articles.summary: Scientists developed AI system to automatically identify coastal rip currents in satellite images, creating new dataset for coastal hazard assessment.
articles.significance: Enables automated coastal hazard monitoring and public safety applications using satellite data
